text:
gotten tons of mileage from this heuristic

break all views/forecasts down into three:

1. what do you WANT to happen?
2. what do you think SHOULD happen?
3. what is ACTUALLY going to happen?

#1 and #2 are worthless, ignore them.

Focus 100% on #3. Its the ONLY one that matters.

quotedTweet.text:
there are three worlds

1. the world as YOU want it to be
2. the world as it is “supposed to be”
3. the world as it ACTUALLY IS. 

worlds 1 and 2 are usually linked and must be smashed at all costs - they are the “veil of Maya” or Schopenhauer’s “principium individuationis” - so that you can live wholly in world 3

nothing causes more misery than miscalibrated expectations and rose-colored goggles. all they do is create a life labored under false illusions

keep your third eye open and remember that “WHAT BREAKS YOUR HEART, FIXES YOUR VISION.”
